summary.text: Paul Tuss is a Democratic state representative from Montana who has represented House District 27 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The executive director of Bear Paw Development Corporation and a former member of the Montana Board of Regents of Higher Education, he serves on the House Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Paul Tuss' career experience includes serving as the executive director of Bear Paw Development Corporation.
He has also served on the Business Advisory Board for MSU-Northern, as an officer of the Havre Area Chamber of Commerce, and as a member of the Montana Board of Regents of Higher Education.
Tuss lost the 2018 general election for Montana State Senate District 14 to incumbent Russel Tempel.
He defeated incumbent Ed Hill in the November 8, 2022 general election for House District 28, and defeated Hill again in House District 27 on November 5, 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the Appropriations Committee and is vice chair of the House Legislative Administration Committee.
